d: Williams discovers the Nation of Islam and changes her ways, while Clemmy and Dangle throw down at a fraternity costume contest.

t: RENO 911!: Clementine and Garcia are Dating
d: After getting it on with nearly every other man in Reno, Johnson finally hooks up with Garcia, and Dangle breaks out his chimney sweep costume.
Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.
Reno's finest take on traffic control for President George W. Bush's motorcade, and Jones and Garcia reenact the Civil War at a pizza parlor.
Garcia shoots a Dungeons & Dragons player, and Junior accidentally gets married during a sting operation.
Reno District Attorney Mike Powers investigates the Sheriff's Department.
District Attorney Mike Powers concludes his investigation of the Sheriff's Department, while Terry the prostitute takes off in Reno's police helicopter.
Members of the Reno Sheriff's Department start new lives after getting kicked off the force.
The deputies enjoy their new lives in the private sector, but a specter from their past continues to haunt them.
Some promising new recruits intimidate the team with their skills, and Wiegel has trouble making magic with her incarcerated boyfriend.
Dangle, Jones and Wiegel lose it in quarantine after exposure to SARS, while the rest of the sheriffs hang out with kids' show host Reading Ron.
The deputies try to catch the infamous Fast Eddie McLintock.
Kimball and Dangle escort the Prefect of Wanganui, Reno's sister city, around town; Junior and Wiegel struggle to stand out at the high school job fair.
Jones discovers the delights of fame after doing radio commercials for a carpeting company.

t: RENO 911!: Clemmy Marries a Dead Guy
d: Johnson tries to marry the late Hot Tub King of Reno, and Garcia and Williams discover the magical properties of Liberace's piano.
Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?
While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.
The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.
After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.

t: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
d: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.
Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?
While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.
The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.
Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.
Spanish Mike Alvarez returns to tempt the deputies, and Jones and Garcia work security at a Ted Nugent concert.
The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.
The investigation into Sheriff Chechekevitch's murder zeroes in on his ex-wife, and Williams and Wiegel attend a Lamaze class.
Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.
Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.
The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.
A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.
Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.
While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.
The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.
Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.
The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.
When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.
